title: Normalized source coordinates for affine conormal base change
statement: Let i:Z→X and i':Z'→X' be closed immersions of schemes [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] in a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with maps g:X→X' and f:Z→Z' and equality i≫g=f≫i'. Fix affine ambient opens U and U' with U contained in g inverse image U'. Put A=Gamma(X',U'), B=Gamma(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U', and S=f*(i'*i'.ker), with module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists an additive equivalence eS from Gamma(S,i inverse image U) to B tensor_A J.Cotangent. For every b in B, a in J and ideal section s' over U' representing a, the inverse eS sends b tensor class(a) to i.app(U)(b) times the restriction of the successive adjunction units of s'. The successive-unit section is transported from (f≫i') inverse image U' to (i≫g) inverse image U' by pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr of the square equality. This statement constructs only the source coordinates, and asserts no property of a conormal morphism or target coordinate.

proof.text: Put A=Gamma(X',U'), B=Gamma(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U'. The inverse-image opens V' and V are affine and the immersion section maps are surjective, by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-affine-cover-criterion]. The given cartesian cone is isomorphic to the chosen pullback. Kernel invariance under that isomorphism and Mathlib IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion identify i.ker with i'.ker.comap g. Apply [lem-pc-ideal-sheaf-comap-affine-extension] to get i.ker.ideal U=JB. The first isomorphism theorem identifies the section rings C=Gamma(Z',V') and D=Gamma(Z,V) with A/J and B/JB; commutativity supplies the compatible induced ring map C to D.

By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-conormal-sections], the conormal sections on V' are J/J^2, normalized on units of ideal representatives. They are C-modules, since the normalization identifies multiplication by the image of an element of A with multiplication by that element modulo J^2. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-affine-sections] to f, V' and V. The induced comparison identifies the source sections with D tensor_C (J/J^2) and sends a pure tensor to the restricted f-unit multiplied by its D-scalar.

The ideal J annihilates J/J^2. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-over-quotient-ring] to cancel the quotient scalar ring A/J. The quotient tensor equivalence for B/JB identifies D tensor_A (J/J^2) with (B tensor_A (J/J^2))/(JB)(B tensor_A (J/J^2)). The denominator is zero: each generator g(a) times (b tensor m) equals b tensor (a times m)=0 for a in J. This gives the required additive equivalence eS. Tracing the pure-tensor formulas yields its inverse at b tensor class(a) as the successive adjunction units of the representing ideal section, multiplied by i.app(b). Composite-adjunction units, pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr h.symm implement the displayed transport; naturality supplies the restriction map.

theorem closedImmersion_conormal_affine_source_coordinates
    {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h))
    (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens) (H : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X', U'.1) Γ(X, U.1) := (g.appLE U'.1 U.1 H).hom.toAlgebra
    let S := (tensorPullback f).obj ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules)
    ∃ eS : Γ(S, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃+ Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(X', U'.1)]
        (i'.ker.ideal U').Cotangent,
      (∀ (b : Γ(X, U.1)) (a : i'.ker.ideal U') (s' : Γ(i'.ker.toModules, U'.1)),
        i'.ker.toModulesι.app U'.1 s' = (a : Γ(X', U'.1)) →
        eS.symm (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').toCotangent a) =
          i.app U.1 b • S.val.map (homOfLE (i.preimage_mono H)).op
            ((((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i')).unit.app
                i'.ker.toModules) ≫
              (pushforward i').map
                (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app
                  ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules))) ≫
              (pushforwardComp f i').hom.app S ≫
              (pushforwardCongr h.symm).hom.app S).app U'.1 s'))
